purpose: Round G: the per-criterion proof level and the pin successors, every test driving bin/rcf.js against a fixture project (e2e): test strength, the Test verdict, Finalise and separation per level (AC-19905-1 to -9, -12), the writer and the enum refusal (AC-19905-10, -11), and the probe shapes at the pin at rcf-schemas 0.11.0 (AC-19905-13 to -15, and the own chain at that pin, AC-19905-16), and the proof downgrade guard: a lightening update refused without a non-empty --reason, the reason recorded in the decisions ledger, creating and tightening direct (AC-19905-17 to -22), and the gate invariant and the blueprint lightening path: rcf build verdict review and light Finalise refuse a criterion lighter at head than at the base without a resolved decision, blueprint version replacement refused without --reason, the reasoned retry idempotent (AC-19905-23 to -30), and the gate failing closed: a passing review verdict refused when the base cannot be resolved, and a resolved decision with an absent, empty or whitespace-only answer counted as undecided at Review and light Finalise (AC-19905-31 to -34), and the gate story discovery from two complete snapshots: a C-quoted, renamed, moved, split or shadowed story, a symlink or gitlink, a duplicated id, an unparseable story or an unreadable blob, a deleted criterion, a lighter successor and a retirement with no successor at Review and light Finalise, and a dirty working tree refusing both (AC-19905-35 to -49), and the gate's base, successor chains, fresh decisions and Finalise at the current HEAD: the base agreement of origin/main and main, a base equal to the judged head, the base recorded in the Review verdict and reused by light Finalise, transitive supersededBy chains, loops, the heaviest from-level, a criterion live again, decisions resolved inside the range, criterion and ledger changes after the reviewed head at Finalise and the TEST verdict, changes main brought, story and ledger classes in rcf/separation.json, merges judged against both parents, a retired criterion deleted, the validating loader, an unrecognised proof value, spelling-independent separation, the test-suite snapshot and touched set, the walker cross-check, a project in a subdirectory and the fault order (AC-19905-50 to -73)
